description: Use when a stateful REST API (resources created, read, changed and deleted in sequence) needs fuzzing that finds multi-step bugs stateless fuzzers miss. Runs Microsoft RESTler from an OpenAPI spec (compile, test, fuzz-lean, fuzz) and reports 5xx errors, resource leaks and hierarchy violations.
